Valerie is an absolute sweetheart, very friendly, compassionate and keen to help the patients in any way she can. I hope I got her name right.

Major shout out to Dr Piccaver. What an amazing, compassionate, intelligent and skillful doctor. If only the other doctors at the surgery were half of the doctor he is. Every time I booked an appointment with him, one way or another my problem got solved. He was very reassuring when I went with my son, I actually felt like someone listened to me for once and my child got the help he needed. He also advocated for me to receive better treatment for a problem that was ignored.

To the other doctors at the surgery, this is a very kind reminder that actually listening to your patients and advocating for them is what leads to better treatments and outcomes.

I couldn't forget Dr Thomas, another amazing doctor and I hope she returns soon. She only saw me ONCE and was able to offer the help I needed for a problem that other doctors at the surgery have continuously dismissed for almost 8 years. I can honestly say she saved me as my mental health was deteriorating due to this problem not being dealt with.

Hopefully, there will be more doctors like them at some
